title: SuperCom Chairman Purchases 19,600 Ordinary Shares and Plans to Purchase Up to 150,000 Shares in Total
summary: /PRNewswire/ -- SuperCom Ltd. (NASDAQ: SPCB), a global provider of secured solutions for the IoT, cybersecurity and digital identity sectors, today announced...
body_markdown:
TEL AVIV, Israel


, Nov. 16, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- SuperCom Ltd. (NASDAQ:SPCB ), a global provider of secured solutions for the IoT, cybersecurity and digital identity sectors, today announced that Mr. Arie Trabelsi, Chairman of its Board of Directors, notified SuperCom that he purchased 19,600 of its ordinary shares in the open market on November 13, 2026, using his personal funds.


The Chairman also informed SuperCom that he intends to purchase up to 150,000 ordinary shares in total, including the shares purchased on November 13, 2026. The Chairman indicated that he views his personal investment as a vote of confidence in SuperCom's business and growth strategy.


The timing and amount of any additional open-market purchases will be at the Chairman's sole discretion, subject to market conditions, applicable law and SuperCom's insider trading policy. There is no assurance that he will purchase any additional shares. The purchases are for the Chairman's personal account. No SuperCom funds have been or will be used for these purchases.


**About SuperCom**


Founded in 1988, SuperCom (NASDAQ:SPCB ) is a global provider of IoT, cybersecurity, and digital identity solutions for governments and enterprises worldwide.


SuperCom's IoT solutions combine proprietary wearable devices, communications technology, and monitoring software to deliver real-time electronic monitoring for public safety. Its PureSecurity suite, including the PureOne GPS monitoring solution and the PureProtect domestic violence monitoring solution, is deployed in government programs across Europe and North America.


Through its wholly owned cybersecurity subsidiary Safend, SuperCom provides endpoint data protection, data loss prevention, encryption, and device and port control solutions, helping organizations protect sensitive information and prevent unauthorized data access and transfer. SuperCom has also introduced SafeGenie, a suite for the real-time monitoring and control of AI agents.


SuperCom also delivers e-Government solutions for secure identification, biometric enrollment, document issuance, and border control.


**For more information, please visit[www.supercom.com](https://www.supercom.com/) .**
